mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 75 degrees at the Verona Public Library, but please note that our air quality is currently at a moderate level of 62.
The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest where residents can vote online through August 7 to pick the artwork that will be featured on stickers for the November election.
Today is packed with activities, including the Downtown Farmers Market and evening trivia, plus keep an eye out for tomorrow, when Concerts in the Park returns to Century School Park.
In our police report for the week, we noted that on July 26, a driver was arrested for an O W I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway.

Today's flavor is Caramel Peanut Buttercup, and since the store opens at 10 AM, you have plenty of time to stop by, plus you can find Kona Ice at Firemans Park from 11 AM to 4 30 PM and at the Farmers Market from 3 PM to 6 30 PM today.
